class.name: SimpleWorldPlacementLibrary
class.brief_description: Registered object profile library for SimpleTerrain world editing.
class.description: [SimpleWorldPlacementLibrary] stores [SimpleWorldObjectProfile] resources that can be selected by editor tools. Placement data references profiles by id, so the library is the stable registry for rebuilds.

method.name: find_profile_index
method.description: Returns the index of the profile with [param id], or [code]-1[/code] if not found.

method.name: get_profile_by_id
method.description: Returns the profile with [param id], or [code]null[/code] if not found.

method.name: get_profile_count
method.description: Returns the number of registered profiles.

method.name: has_profile_id
method.description: Returns whether a profile with [param id] exists.

method.name: remove_profile_by_id
method.description: Removes the profile with [param id] if it exists.
